title.zh: 【泰国 SEC 发布 11 项加密 ETF 新规，首阶段仅允许 ETF 投资比特币和以太坊】
title.en: 【泰国 SEC 发布 11 项加密 ETF 新规，首阶段仅允许 ETF 投资比特币和以太坊】

current_state.zh: Thailand's SEC issued 11 crypto ETF regulations effective October 16, allowing only passive BTC and ETH exposure in the first phase with an 80% minimum net asset exposure and regulated custody, while permitting mutual/private funds to invest in domestic crypto ETFs and barring brokers from margin financing and from serving non-institutional clients with offshore crypto ETFs.
current_state.en: Thailand's SEC issued 11 crypto ETF regulations effective October 16, allowing only passive BTC and ETH exposure in the first phase with an 80% minimum net asset exposure and regulated custody, while permitting mutual/private funds to invest in domestic crypto ETFs and barring brokers from margin financing and from serving non-institutional clients with offshore crypto ETFs.
